latest.title: AI build-out hits snag as Google and Microsoft put off raising capex forecasts

latest.title: Merck tops quarterly estimates, hikes profit outlook as new Keytruda form shows strength

latest.title: U.S. worker job engagement hits lowest level since 2011, new Gallup poll finds
latest.description: Gallup finds U.S. worker engagement on the job sinking to a level not seen since 2011, with remote and hybrid employees and AI primary factors.

latest.title: Bitcoin drops to $80,000 on Fed dissent, Samsung, Alphabet earnings; AI tokens slump
latest.description: Bitcoin fell 1.4% since midnight UTC to around $80,100 as disappointing reports from Samsung and Alphabet weighed on tech stocks. The Fed’s preferred inflation gauge is due later today.
